display.label: AWS IAM Role
display.description: Provision AWS IAM Roles with trust relationships, managed policy attachments, and inline policies

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique friendly name for the IAM role.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core IAM role settings including name, path, and description.

fields.label: Role Name
fields.description: Friendly name of the IAM role. Conflicts with name_prefix.

validation.pattern_error: Role name must only contain alphanumeric characters and symbols +=,.@_-

fields.label: Role Name Prefix
fields.description: Creates a unique friendly name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with name.

fields.label: Path
fields.description: Path to the IAM role. Must begin and end with a forward slash (/).

validation.pattern_error: Path must begin and end with a forward slash (/).

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Description of the role's purpose and usage.

sections.label: Trust Policy & Permissions
sections.description: Entity trust relationship and permission boundary configurations.

fields.label: Assume Role Policy Document
fields.description: JSON formatted trust policy document granting entities permission to assume this role.

fields.label: Permissions Boundary ARN
fields.description: ARN of the managed policy that sets the permissions boundary for the role.

sections.label: Session & Lifecycle Management
sections.description: Session duration limits and policy detachment settings.

fields.label: Max Session Duration (Seconds)
fields.description: Maximum session duration in seconds (from 3600 to 43200).

fields.label: Force Detach Policies
fields.description: Force detachment of attached policies prior to destroying the role.

sections.label: Policy Attachments
sections.description: Managed policies and inline policies attached to this role.

fields.label: Managed Policy ARNs
fields.description: List of AWS managed policy ARNs to attach to the role.

fields.label: Inline Policies
fields.description: List of inline policy objects defining policy name and JSON document.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for organizational, tracking, and cost allocation purposes.

fields.label: Role Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the IAM role.
